Astronomer in Residence 2026 

Blog: Follow Along with Us!

Seneca Smith AIR Term: Aug 24 - Aug 28 2026

Seneca Smith is a communicator, teacher, and lover of science. With experience in both physics and data science, Seneca believes in finding the story within the data to make the obscure relatable and the mundane magical. As the vice-president of the Barbados Astronomical Society, Seneca is passionate about ensuring that everyone has access to the wonders of astronomy, regardless of their background. 

Currently a secondary school physics teacher, Seneca uses their passions for exploration, photography and making music to continue learning and teaching outside the classroom whenever possible.

Link to Blog: https://www.yorku.ca/science/observatory/air/astronomer-in-residence-blog/
